name: When should I consider getting a roof ridge assessment for my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider getting a roof ridge assessment for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a roof ridge assessment after severe weather, such as hail or high winds, or if you notice any signs of leaks inside your home. Regular assessments are also recommended every 3-5 years, especially for roofs approaching 10-15 years old. Our team in the DFW area frequently sees ridge damage from common local weather events, making proactive checks a good practice to prevent minor issues from becoming major problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a roof ridge assessment after severe weather, if you notice leaks, or as part of routine maintenance every 3-5 years, especially for older roofs.
